App BarNavigation

The `m3e-app-bar` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Anatomy

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.appBar []
[ M3e.AppBar.leading (M3e.iconButton [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Back" ] [ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_back" ] [] ])
, M3e.AppBar.title (Kit.text "Top 10 hiking trails")
, M3e.AppBar.subtitle (Kit.text "Discover popular trails")
, M3e.AppBar.trailing
(M3e.iconButton
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Bookmark"
, M3e.IconButton.variant M3e.Values.tonal
]
[ M3e.icon
[ M3e.Icon.name "bookmark"
, M3e.Icon.filled True
]
[]
]
)
]

el is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the el surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for el on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

M3e.AppBar.build
|> M3e.AppBar.withLeading (M3e.IconButton.view [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Back" ] [ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_back" ] [] ])
|> M3e.AppBar.withTitle (Kit.text "Top 10 hiking trails")
|> M3e.AppBar.withSubtitle (Kit.text "Discover popular trails")
|> M3e.AppBar.withTrailing
(M3e.IconButton.view
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Bookmark"
, M3e.IconButton.variant M3e.Values.tonal
]
[ M3e.Icon.view
[ M3e.Icon.name "bookmark"
, M3e.Icon.filled True
]
[]
]
)
|> M3e.AppBar.toElement
<m3e-app-bar>
<m3e-icon-button slot="leading" aria-label="Back">
<m3e-icon name="arrow_back"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<span slot="title">Top 10 hiking trails</span>
<span slot="subtitle">Discover popular trails</span>
<m3e-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Bookmark" variant="tonal">
<m3e-icon name="bookmark" filled=""></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
</m3e-app-bar>

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.AppBar.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.AppBar.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.AppBar.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children].

type Is

The kind row m3e-app-bar produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type LeadingSlot

The kinds the leading slot admits.

type SubtitleSlot

The kinds the subtitle slot admits.

type TitleSlot

The kinds the title slot admits.

type TrailingSlot

The kinds the trailing slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Size

The size values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Other

size : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.AppBar.Size -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | size : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The size of the bar. (default: "small")

centered : Basics.Bool -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | centered : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.centered.

for : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | for : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.for.

leading : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.AppBar.LeadingSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named leading slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

leadingIcon : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named leading-icon slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

subtitle : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.AppBar.SubtitleSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named subtitle slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

title : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.AppBar.TitleSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named title slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

trailing : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.AppBar.TrailingSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named trailing slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

trailingIcon : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named trailing-icon slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).
